name: Beautiful.ai
tagline: Beautiful.ai is an AI-powered presentation tool that auto-formats slides as you add content, keeping designs consistently polished without manual tweaking. Smart slide templates adapt to your data: charts resize, images recrop, and layouts adjust automatically. It's popular with business teams who need professional-looking decks without a design background.
